architecturalDecisions.title: Bulk mode stays inside grocery list route
architecturalDecisions.decision: Bulk Selection Mode is an in-page state within the existing grocery list experience and does not introduce a new route.

architecturalDecisions.title: Unchecked-only selectable scope
architecturalDecisions.decision: Selectable entities are existing unchecked grocery items; checked items are hidden while mode is active.

architecturalDecisions.title: Soft-delete remains canonical delete behavior
architecturalDecisions.decision: Bulk delete and move source removal use existing soft-delete semantics on grocery items rather than hard deletes.

architecturalDecisions.title: Existing picker surfaces are reused
architecturalDecisions.decision: Bulk store, category, and move actions reuse the existing store/category/list selection sheets to preserve interaction consistency.

architecturalDecisions.title: Permission boundaries unchanged
architecturalDecisions.decision: All bulk writes continue through existing InstantDB permission boundaries used by grocery list members and owners.

architecturalDecisions.title: Deterministic move conflict semantics
architecturalDecisions.decision: Bulk move applies deterministic destination merge/increment rules and then removes source items for true transfer semantics.

phases.title: Bulk Mode Foundation
userStories: Enter bulk mode from list menu and exit intentionally
Restrict selection to unchecked items and hide checked rows
Use row tap and checkbox as selection controls
Disable edit interactions while in bulk mode
Keep filter/sort/grouping dropdown visible in bulk mode
Expose Select All and Clear All utilities
Clear selection state on exit

tickets.title: Add bulk mode controller with explicit state transitions
tickets.summary: Introduce a dedicated bulk-selection controller that manages mode status, selected item ids, unchecked-only selection scope, and reset-on-exit behavior so UI layers consume a stable contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Controller supports enter mode, exit mode, toggle item, select all visible unchecked items, and clear all.
Selecting a checked item is prevented by controller rules even if attempted by UI.
Exiting mode always clears the selected-item set.
testPlan: Add unit tests covering enter/exit, unchecked-only scope, toggle semantics, select-all, and clear-all.
Run `pnpm test -- --run`.
Run `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

tickets.title: Wire grocery list UI into bulk mode foundation
tickets.summary: Integrate bulk mode state into grocery list header and rows so menu entry, close action, row/checkbox toggles, edit suppression, checked-row hiding, and section clear suppression all follow mode rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Overflow menu shows an enter-bulk action when mode is inactive.
Header replaces list-name/change-list affordance with Select All/Clear All while mode is active, keeps the filter/sort/grouping dropdown available, and keeps the exit control in the top-right.
Checked rows are not rendered during bulk mode.
Row press and checkbox both toggle selection in bulk mode.
Item edit entry points and section-level clear controls are unavailable in bulk mode.
testPlan: Add integration tests for entering/exiting mode and selection interactions.
Manual check: verify checked rows disappear and editing does not open while mode is active.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

phases.title: Toolbar Transition and Mode Presentation
userStories: Cross-fade standard bottom controls to bulk toolbar
Use clear iconography and action ordering
Disable toolbar actions with zero selection

tickets.title: Implement bottom control cross-fade for mode transitions
tickets.summary: Add animation state that fades default nav/add controls out and bulk toolbar in at the same bottom alignment zone to provide a clear mode-change affordance.
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk mode activation visually transitions from standard controls to bulk toolbar in approximately 200ms.
Exiting bulk mode restores standard controls with the reverse transition.
Layout does not jump during transition on common device sizes.
testPlan: Manual check on iOS and Android simulators for transition smoothness and alignment.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.
outOfScope: Action handler implementations for toolbar buttons

tickets.title: Render disabled-aware bulk toolbar shell
tickets.summary: Add the bulk toolbar action shell in final order with required icons and disabled state behavior tied to selection count to establish the interaction surface before write flows are attached.
acceptanceCriteria: Toolbar action order is Set Store, Set Category, Move, Delete.
Toolbar actions use designated icons and destructive affordance on delete.
All actions are disabled when no items are selected and enabled otherwise.
testPlan: Add UI test assertions for button order and zero-selection disabled state.
Manual check: destructive action appears as the right-most action.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

phases.title: Bulk Delete Vertical Slice
userStories: Require confirmation before deleting selected items
Apply existing soft-delete behavior
Exit mode and show success confirmation after action
Respect shared-list permissions

tickets.title: Implement bulk delete orchestrator path
tickets.summary: Build the delete action flow that prompts confirmation with selected-count context, executes soft-delete updates for selected grocery items, and then resets mode state without showing a success toast.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete action opens a confirmation prompt showing selected item count.
Confirming delete marks all selected items deleted using existing soft-delete semantics.
Successful delete exits bulk mode and clears selection without showing a success toast.
Canceling delete performs no writes and keeps current mode state.
testPlan: Add unit tests for delete orchestrator success and cancel paths.
Manual check: collaboration scenario still enforces permission boundaries.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

phases.title: Bulk Store and Category Vertical Slice
userStories: Reuse existing store/category sheets for bulk updates
Allow None to clear store/category
Best-effort saved-item sync does not block grocery-item updates
Exit mode and show success confirmation after action
Respect shared-list permissions

tickets.title: Attach store and category sheets to bulk action shell
tickets.summary: Wire bulk Set Store and Set Category actions to existing picker sheets, including None semantics, selected-count aware submission, and disabled behavior inherited from selection state.
acceptanceCriteria: Set Store action opens existing store picker surface and returns selected store or None.
Set Category action opens existing category picker surface and returns selected category or None.
Submitting either action targets currently selected items only.
testPlan: Add integration tests ensuring both actions open reused sheets and receive values.
Manual check: selecting None clears values intent for all selected items.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

tickets.title: Implement bulk store/category write adapter with best-effort sync
tickets.summary: Implement a bulk write adapter that updates grocery items for selected records and performs linked saved-item synchronization on a best-effort basis so partial sync failures do not fail the primary bulk operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Store/category values are updated across all selected grocery items in one bulk action flow.
Choosing None clears the respective field on selected grocery items.
Saved-item sync attempts occur where linkage permits, and skipped/failed syncs do not fail grocery-item updates.
Successful action exits bulk mode and clears selection without showing a success toast.
testPlan: Add unit tests for best-effort sync behavior including partial failure scenarios.
Manual check with mixed linked/unlinked items to confirm grocery updates still succeed.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

phases.title: Bulk Move Vertical Slice
userStories: Reuse existing list-selection sheet for move destination
Show current list as disabled option
Apply true move semantics (remove source after destination write)
Merge/increment destination conflicts deterministically
Preserve checked-state semantics and permission safety
Exit mode and show success confirmation after action

tickets.title: Wire move action to list picker with current-list guard
tickets.summary: Connect the bulk Move action to the existing grocery-list selector flow with clear current-list orientation, preventing same-list destination submission while still showing the current list in the destination context.
acceptanceCriteria: Move action opens reused list-selection sheet.
Current list is visible but not selectable as destination.
Move confirmation is blocked until a valid destination list is selected.
testPlan: Add integration tests for destination picker behavior and same-list disable rule.
Manual check: current list remains visible in picker context.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.

tickets.title: Implement move planner and executor semantics
tickets.summary: Implement move planning and execution that creates or merges destination items per deterministic stacking rules, then removes source items to enforce true transfer behavior with permission-safe writes.
acceptanceCriteria: When selected source items conflict with destination items, quantities are merged/incremented using deterministic rules.
When no conflict exists, destination receives new item records with expected field values.
Source selected items are removed only after successful destination application.
Successful action exits bulk mode and clears selection without showing a success toast.
testPlan: Add unit tests for move planning outputs: merge, create, and source removal steps.
Manual check with mixed conflict/non-conflict selections across two lists.
Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm tsc --noEmit`.
